hero.looks: The page opening: a large heading over a full-width photo (or a plain background), an optional breadcrumb, intro text, up to three buttons and an optional side panel.
hero.use: The first block of almost every page; one per page.

fields.content_text: The page heading. Keep it short.
fields.content_textHtml: One or two sentences under the heading.
fields.media_image: The background photo. Offer options with find_images.
fields.media_featuredImage: Optional second image beside the text.
fields.media_video: Optional background video (MP4); leave empty unless asked.
fields.panel_title: Optional side panel. Leave every panel_ field empty for no panel.
fields.markerTerms: Optional words from the heading to highlight, exactly as written, separated by |.
